title: Brython Performance Audit
objective: Audit upstream Brython benchmarks and report matched runtime measurements with attribution

handoff.summary: Research-only source audit with attributed upstream fixtures, four-engine local measurements, native/guarded exception probes and browser literal-pooling diagnosis. No production runtime changes.
risks: Local shared Linux host reconnaissance, not four-platform acceptance or reproduction of the published website.
Trivial discarded results are JIT-sensitive; timings exclude startup and compilation.
next_steps: Qualify browser literal pooling and profile construction/binding on observable package workloads.
